Photos.Caption: Wrong Wheel Frame for Spirit II, E-210

Results.ReviewText:
On April 19, 2021, a Weber Spirit II gas grill was ordered.  It arrived on April 25th.  Assembly began immediately and it was soon discovered that the wheel frame (see photo) to which the wheels were to be attached was incorrect.  One of the bent “legs” could not be inserted therein.  A call was placed to Weber where I was informed that a replacement part would be sent to me.  It arrived four days later and assembly began again.  The part received worked fine.  However, two  tabs on one other of the smaller items were bent.  Fortunately, with a pair of pliers,  I was able to return it to its proper position and complete the assembly.  

To comment further, the Weber person with whom I was relating the problem to was very friendly and helpful.  Also, in that there was an enormous amount of tape (top, bottom, and sides) I wonder if perhaps  the grill  had been returned by someone because of the wrong part, and that it was re-shipped to me.  

The grill has been used one time.  It works fine, and I am satisfied with the results obtained.
Results.Title: Wrong Wheel Frame

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
